item.title: Slip hazard - slippery flooring/green algae around water play feature, 12th September
item.description:
Hello, The floor around the water play features in the Belvedere Beach Park is covered in green algae. My daughter fell over and hurt herself on it yesterday and I see other people fall regularly in that area. I have reported it before and it was cleaned to good effect. However, a now missing warning sign seemed to have replaced a regular cleaning schedule (or work to make the area drain more efficiently) which is very disappointing, and does nothing to prevent potentially dangerous accidents. Could green algae be properly removed from the area again? Many thanks.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Heron Hill, Upper Belvedere, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
